Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Describes a plain table the planner is about to scan and collects the custom scan paths offered for it.

```csharp
public readonly ref struct PgCustomScanPlanner
```

The planner is valid only during [Plan(PgCustomScanPlanner)](/api/ankus.ipgcustomscan-1/#member-e34f5af3afedc0a8). Ankus offers ordinary tables and
materialized views, including inheritance children and partitions. It does not offer tables whose rows the query
locks or modifies, or whose system columns it reads, because a custom scan's rows have no physical location.

### AddPath(PgCustomScanPath)

Offers a path. The planner keeps it only if no other path is cheaper for every purpose.

```csharp
public void AddPath(PgCustomScanPath path)
```

Parameters:

`path` — [PgCustomScanPath](/api/ankus.pgcustomscanpath/)

The path's costs, optional row estimate, data and sort keys.

Exceptions:

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): A cost or row estimate is negative or not finite, the total cost
            is below the startup cost, or a sort key is not a column of the table.
- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): A sort key names a dropped column.

<a id="member-c0b8a89d8b26d59e"></a>

### IsColumnRead(int)

Gets whether the query reads a column from this table's rows, for its output or its conditions.

```csharp
public bool IsColumnRead(int ordinal)
```

Parameters:

`ordinal` — [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)

The column's zero-based position in [Descriptor](/api/ankus.pgcustomscanplanner/#member-2f62b81003040c8b).

Returns: [bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

Whether the column is read, so that a path's cost can include only the columns it must produce.

Exceptions:

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): <code class="paramref">ordinal</code> is not a column of the table.
